Home Industries Solutions & Services About us Contact About Soliton Telmec Soliton Telmec Limited is a telecommunications technology company with their head office based in Nairobi, Kenya. The company was established in 2005, after evolving from Soliton Systems. We build and support both the basic and complex infrastructure required to enable electronic communications across the nation which include data centers, fiber optic lines; and the related routing and transmission equipment, including on-going support backed by a Service Level Agreement. With subsidiary offices in Uganda, Kampala and a branch in Mombasa, Kenya to support project implementation in the region, we provide services across the East Africa region. QHSE Policy Building Networks for Life Soliton Telmec has delivered in planning, design, construction, maintenance and support of long haul projects, metro fiber connectivity and FTTx solutions. We have done over 6,000Km of long distance backbone projects in different counties in the country; Nyeri, Kajiado, Kiambu-Garissa-Mombasa and Nakuru counties. We have constructed metro networks in major counties and cities in Kenya such as Nairobi, Mombasa and Kisumu cities, Nakuru, Uasin Gishu, Nyeri, Garissa, Meru, Embu, Kiambu and Laikipia. Soliton has successfully implemented the first ever FTTH project in the region in Nairobi's Runda Estate covering over 100 residences.
